recommendation: Keep the empty audit commit. No follow-up core source change is needed for FHIR-27812 unless a future work-group decision changes the conformance strength or safety guidance for modifier elements returned under _elements.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive FHIR-core-search issue asking to align _elements advice for clients and servers by advising both to pay attention to mandatory elements and modifier elements.
initial_application: Historical commit 22b2855454d1fdcabe258f22b89290ad4a6e4c35 changed source/search.html from advising servers to return mandatory elements to advising them to return mandatory and modifier elements whether requested or not.
additional_context: FHIR-31655 later clarified adjacent client/server responsibility wording and cited FHIR-27812, preserving the mandatory/modifier safety model. FHIR-43354 later removed the confusing word "always" from the same server SHOULD sentence and added a RESTful API note, while retaining mandatory and modifier elements. FHIR-I minutes from 2020-06-22 record FHIR-27812 as "Will list modifiers for server too" with an 8-0-0 vote.
reconciliation: No source change was made because source/search.html already says returned elements generally include explicitly requested elements, mandatory elements, or modifier elements with values, and servers SHOULD return mandatory and modifier elements whether requested or not.
